title: ERC Work Programme 2026 - eligibility period extensions (maternity/paternity leave)
notes: OK (18 months per child). Section 1.4.2.2, p.18: 'Maternity leave: an 18-month extension per child born before or after the Principal Investigator's PhD Defence Date' (longer if actual leave longer); paternity/parental leave: documented amount per child (p.19).
